title: Marconi radar and the Italian crash

tellings.quote:
not
just in Cape
Gerardo but maybe in Italy as well
because Marone was involved

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, suggests to Michels that a crashed craft may have been recovered not only at Cape Girardeau, a US town tied to an older crash story, but in Italy as well. His reason is that the Italian radio pioneer Guglielmo Marconi "was involved". He mentions it briefly, without a source, and does not spell out what Marconi's part was.
